::: {#lem-rss-ols-fit}
#### Residual sum of squares of the OLS fit

If $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
the [residual sum of squares](#def-rss)
at the OLS estimates (@thm-ols-slr) is

$$\text{RSS}(\hintcoef, \hcoef{x}) = \sumin \resid_\iobs^2 = \ssout - \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred}.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-rss-ols-fit.

:::
